description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Furystoke Giant.
When Furystoke Giant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Furystoke Giant.
When Furystoke Giant dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
